Subject: Discovery recap + proposed next steps

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Great conversation — wanted to capture the highlights and propose next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary from today
- Key goals: reduce inference cost by ~40% on long-tail queries, get to P99 latency <200ms for web traffic, and enable private deployment for PHI workloads.
- Primary workloads: conversational support and nightly batch embeddings for search re-ranking.
- Concerns: data residency + audit logs, deterministic fallbacks for incidents.

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep dive / demo (60 min) w/ our Solutions Engineering team to walk architecture, benchmarks, and proposed deployment patterns (private VPC + dedicated capacity).
2) Executive alignment (15–20 min) with your VP/CTO to confirm timelines and contractual constraints before we scope a pilot.

Can you please share Tom Alvarez (CTO) or the VP who should join the exec alignment? Below are a couple of windows we have next week for the technical deep dive — happy to expand if none of these work:
- Tue 17 Feb — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 18 Feb — 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 19 Feb — 09:00–10:00 PT

I attached the discovery notes and an initial requirement map so we can iterate. If you prefer, I can send a calendar poll.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
